editions.title: This weekend in motorsport
editions.intro: Looking ahead to 7–12 October, we have action across Formula 1, MotoGP and the NASCAR Cup Series. Round 17 sees racing in Singapore and Indonesia, while round 32 of NASCAR heads to Charlotte.

items.headline: Singapore Grand Prix
items.detail: Marina Bay Street Circuit, Singapore · Sun 11 Oct
items.body: The Singapore Grand Prix takes place on Sun 11 Oct at the Marina Bay Street Circuit from 12:00 UTC. Andrea Kimi Antonelli holds an 84-point championship lead over George Russell. The weekend includes sprint qualifying on Fri 9 Oct at 12:30 UTC, with the sprint and qualifying both held on Saturday.
facts: Andrea Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 84 points from George Russell

items.headline: Grand Prix of Indonesia
items.detail: Pertamina Mandalika Circuit, Indonesia · Sun 11 Oct
items.body: The Grand Prix of Indonesia arrives at the Pertamina Mandalika Circuit on Sun 11 Oct. Jorge Martin holds a narrow two-point advantage in the championship over Marc Marquez.
facts: Jorge Martin leads the championship by 2 points from Marc Marquez

items.headline: Bank of America 400
items.detail: Charlotte Motor Speedway · Sun 11 Oct
items.body: The Bank of America 400 runs at Charlotte Motor Speedway on Sun 11 Oct from 19:00 UTC. This 400.5-mile race covers 267 laps, with US coverage provided by USA and PRN radio.

editions.title: Last week in motorsport
editions.intro: Racing action spanned several championships during the week of 29 September to 5 October. From Formula 1 and MotoGP to the NASCAR Cup Series and the WRC, there was plenty to follow across the globe.

items.headline: Motul Petit Le Mans
items.detail: Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta · Sat 3 Oct
items.body: The Motul Petit Le Mans took place at Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta on Saturday 3 October.

items.headline: Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia
items.detail: Sepang International Circuit, Malaysia · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: Max Verstappen won the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia for Red Bull. Andrea Kimi Antonelli finished second for Mercedes, while Lewis Hamilton took third for Ferrari.

items.headline: Grand Prix of Japan
items.detail: Mobility Resort Motegi, Japan · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: Marc Marquez won the Grand Prix of Japan in Motegi for the Ducati Lenovo Team. Jorge Martin and Marco Bezzecchi completed the podium, both riding for Aprilia Racing.

items.headline: South Point 400
items.detail: Las Vegas Motor Speedway · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: Chase Briscoe won the South Point 400 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway for Joe Gibbs Racing, leading 175 of the 267 laps. Kyle Larson for Hendrick Motorsports and Tyler Reddick for 23XI Racing finished second and third respectively, with a margin of victory of 1.376 seconds.

items.headline: Midwest Nationals
items.detail: World Wide Technology Raceway, Illinois · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: The Midwest Nationals were held at the World Wide Technology Raceway in Illinois on Sunday 4 October.

items.headline: Rally Italia Sardegna
items.detail: Alghero, Italy · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: Rally Italia Sardegna took place in Alghero, Italy, on Sunday 4 October.

items.body: Chase Briscoe won the South Point 400 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway, leading 175 of the 267 laps. Kyle Larson and Tyler Reddick finished second and third in a race that saw 12 lead changes among seven drivers and four cautions.

lastRaces.headline: South Point 400
lastRaces.detail: Las Vegas Motor Speedway · Sun 4 Oct
lastRaces.body: Chase Briscoe from Joe Gibbs Racing won the South Point 400 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway, ahead of Kyle Larson for Hendrick Motorsports and Tyler Reddick with 23XI Racing. Briscoe led 175 laps during a race that saw 12 lead changes among seven drivers.

lastRaces.headline: Grand Prix of Japan
lastRaces.detail: Mobility Resort Motegi, Japan · Sun 4 Oct
lastRaces.body: Marc Marquez of Ducati Lenovo Team won the Grand Prix of Japan, followed by Jorge Martin and Marco Bezzecchi, both with Aprilia Racing. Martin leads the championship by just two points over Marquez.
facts: Jorge Martin leads the championship by 2 points from Marc Marquez

lastRaces.headline: Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia
lastRaces.detail: Sepang International Circuit, Malaysia · Sun 4 Oct
lastRaces.body: Max Verstappen won the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia for Red Bull, followed by Andrea Kimi Antonelli for Mercedes and Lewis Hamilton for Ferrari. Antonelli leads the championship by 84 points from George Russell.
facts: Andrea Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 84 points from George Russell

lastRaces.headline: Motul Petit Le Mans
lastRaces.detail: Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta · Sat 3 Oct
lastRaces.body: The Motul Petit Le Mans was held at Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta. This round took place on Saturday 3 October.

lastRaces.headline: 6 Hours of Fuji
lastRaces.body: The 6 Hours of Fuji was held at Fuji Speedway, Japan. It ran on Sunday 27 September.

lastRaces.headline: Baku
lastRaces.detail: Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan · Sun 27 Sep
lastRaces.body: The Formula 2 action returned to the Baku City Circuit in Azerbaijan on Sunday 27 September for round 12. It was a busy weekend of racing on the streets of Baku.

lastRaces.headline: Spa-Francorchamps
lastRaces.detail: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps, Belgium · Sat 19 Sep
lastRaces.body: The Clio Cup Series visited Spa-Francorchamps on Saturday 19 September for round 5. The circuit features a 7.004 km lap with 19 corners and has been racing since 1921.

lastRaces.headline: Madrid
lastRaces.body: The tenth round of Formula 3 was held in Madrid, Spain, on Sunday 13 September.

lastRaces.headline: Monza (double-header)
lastRaces.detail: Autodromo Nazionale Monza, Italy · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: The seventh round of the Porsche Supercup was a double-header at Autodromo Nazionale Monza in Italy on Sunday 6 September. This circuit features an 11-corner, 5.793 km lap and was first raced in 1922.

lastRaces.headline: Season Finale
lastRaces.detail: WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: The IndyCar season concluded with its finale at WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca on Sunday 6 September.

lastRaces.headline: London E-Prix
lastRaces.body: Taylor Barnard took victory at the London E-Prix for DS Penske, ahead of Mahindra Racing's Nyck De Vries and Edoardo Mortara. Pascal Wehrlein leads the championship by 5 points from Jake Dennis.
facts: Pascal Wehrlein leads the championship by 5 points from Jake Dennis
